title: Understanding the Scree Plot
text: Look at the scree plot and identify where the curve starts to level off. This point indicates the number of principal components that capture most of the variance.

title: Intrinsic Dimension
text: The intrinsic dimension is often determined by the number of principal components before the curve levels off. How many components are there before this happens?

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Based on the scree plot, does the intrinsic dimension appear to be less than 20?
